description: View the safety audit trail — a forensics log of what sandboxed MCP servers did and what the sandbox blocked (tool calls, blocked tools, blocked/allowed network egress, connects with granted capabilities). Use `securityOnly: true` to see only blocks and errors.

event.description: Filter to a single event type

limit.description: Max events to return (default 50, newest first)

securityOnly.description: Show only security-relevant events (blocks + errored calls)

slug.description: Filter to a single server slug

name: mcp_audit
